_about: Decoupling requirements per part family (R2 / W22). General source: it names families, never a board or a project. An entry is allowed only when its cited file is in the general sources (shared/reference) and the file's text confirms EVERY value of the entry: 'cite' = {file: path under shared/reference, page: number (1-based; a .pdf page, or a form-feed page of a text file), figure: 'Figure N' as printed (optional), confirm: [one regex per value that must match the text of that page]}. tests/test_decap_families.py opens each cited file and checks the page and every confirm pattern. A pin whose part matches no entry is read from a strict one-line power-supply row of its own datasheet text, otherwise it is NOT CHECKED with the reason. Entry: {id, match: regex on the part number, groups: [{pin: regex on a pin-name token, schemes: [{per_pin: [slot], per_device: [slot], cite}]}]}; slot = {role: 'hf' (a ceramic of 1x to 10x the value) | 'bulk' (0.4x to 10x), farads}. per_pin slots are asked once for every pin of the group, per_device once for the part; schemes are alternatives the source allows. No entry yet: no ST datasheet, reference manual or application note with a confirmable decoupling figure is in the general sources.
